SWIGGY_ONE.cardBuyDescription: Get 3 months of Swiggy One subscription at just ₹19
SWIGGY_ONE.cardRedeemDescription: Congratulations! You have redeemed Swiggy One subscription at just ₹19
details: Swiggy one at just ₹19 can only bought through Refyne
redeemSteps: Update the app before redeeming the coupon
Open the updated Swiggy app and go to your Swiggy Accounts page
Select the "One membership" tab and click on "Redeem Membership Coupon"
Enter your coupon code and click on the activate button to start Swiggy One Lite membership.
termsAndConditions: The voucher codes are issued by Swiggy to activate Swiggy One membership.
All transactions on the Platform will be subject to the other terms and conditions of provision of Services, as enumerated in https://www.swiggy.com/ terms-and-conditions.
Once the membership is activated, it cannot be cancelled or any refund will not be issued.
The distances from the restaurant location to the customer's location shall be captured as per Google
Map driving directions data at the time of placing the Order. Swiggy shall not be held responsible or liable for the accuracy or efficacy of such data.
Swiggy One benefits are available to orders above a certain amount as mentioned in the benefit section.
Additional discounts specific to the Swiggy One program will be applicable on the discounted values of the food items post application of any generally available coupons on the Platform.
